backlog-management.name: backlog management
backlog-management.definition: The process of organizing and prioritizing the items in a backlog within an Agile development framework.

agile-methodology.name: Agile methodology
agile-methodology.definition: A project management approach that emphasizes iterative progress, flexibility, and collaboration among team members.

deployment-context.name: deployment context
deployment-context.definition: Information about the last deployment, including resources deployed, their status, and errors.

ai-native-features.name: AI-native features
ai-native-features.definition: Features designed to integrate AI capabilities directly into the ICE platform with varying priorities and statuses.

openai-compatible-api.name: OpenAI-compatible API
openai-compatible-api.definition: An API that conforms to OpenAI's chat completion protocol, allowing seamless integration with various AI providers.

user-friendly-properties.name: User-Friendly Properties
user-friendly-properties.definition: Rewriting properties from technical jargon to intent-based options, including adding fields and layers for better configuration.

connections.description: Backlog management is a key practice within the Agile framework.
The project applies concepts from backlog management to improve the AI assistant’s functionality.
Information stored in CanvasDeployment is part of the deployment context.
The Flash-MoE backend is part of the @ice/ai package.
The @ice/ai package uses an OpenAI-compatible API for its FlashMoeProvider.
Flash-MoE is part of the AI-Native Features.
Ghost Mode is a feature within AI-Native Features.
AI error diagnosis is part of the AI-Native Features.
Pre-deploy security/cost warnings are a feature within AI-Native Features.

raw/backlog/frontend.md.summary: This document discusses the concepts and practices related to backlog management in software development, focusing on its role within the Agile methodology.

raw/backlog/ai-read-capabilities.md.summary: The document discusses the current state and proposed solutions for enhancing an AI assistant's capabilities to provide information about deployed cloud infrastructure, including deployment context, live cloud status queries, and logs & metrics integration.

raw/backlog/ai-native-features.md.summary: This document describes Feature 0: Flash-MoE as Default AI Backend, part of a project to make ICE an AI-first cloud platform with self-contained AI features.

raw/backlog/JULIA.md.summary: The document provides a structured overview of the backlog for ICE, detailing various features and tasks across different categories such as AI-native features, user-friendly properties, missing blocks, templates, and frontend polish.
